lines.text: THE promise is fulfill’d Salvation work is done Mercy and truth in unison The Son of God arose.
Oh my soul, praise the Lord Who all thy sins doth bear He died for the sins of the world He came to die no more.
His death purchas’d our rest And for thee He arose Believe and be fully pardon‘d Who was marked with the blood.
